- 19:06 MT added pytest-xdist 3.8.0 (uv add --dev, uv.lock +execnet, nothing else moved). Isolation choice: one Postgres container per xdist worker. The session fixture pg_url runs once per worker process (each xdist worker is its own pytest session). Chosen over one container with a database per worker because many tests do cluster-global things that a shared cluster would make collide: fixed role names (CREATE ROLE t9_owner/bk_owner/...), fixed database names (t9_lp, breaker_lp, breaker_tz, search_path_trader), pg_terminate_backend, and the single-instance advisory lock. A container per worker keeps each worker's cluster exactly what the serial run sees, with no test changes. Cost: ~2-3 s start and ~50 MB per container (Docker VM has 8 CPU / 8 GB).
- 19:06 MT first -n 4 --dist loadfile run started (loadfile keeps each module on one worker, so module-scoped fixtures such as the extra containers in integration/test_prod_db_setup.py and gauntlet/test_p6_t6_breaker.py start once, and module order is as in the serial run).
- 19:12 MT run 1 (-n 4 --dist loadfile, no test changes): 3629 passed in 353.28 s (5:53), wall 354 s. No failure: nothing xdist-unsafe surfaced. Individual DB-heavy tests ran ~2x slower than serial (e.g. golden week 20 -> 42 s): 4 clusters writing at once.
- 19:13 MT conftest pg_url: session container now starts with fsync=off, synchronous_commit=off, full_page_writes=off. Test-only. Tests that pin server settings have their own containers.

- xdist-unsafe tests found: none. Checked by grep (fixed /tmp paths, fixed ports, os.environ writes, cluster-global DB names/roles) and by five parallel runs (loadfile x4, worksteal x1): every test that binds uses port 0, every file uses tmp_path, env changes go through monkeypatch, and the cluster-global DB work (fixed roles/databases, pg_terminate_backend, advisory locks) is private because each worker has its own container. No xdist_group markers and no serialized tests were needed.
- Sleeps: only the decisions/test_wiring teardown (3 s) could use a fake without changing the proof (done). Left as real time on purpose: decisions/test_wiring::test_a_gate_blocking_3_s_in_its_thread_does_not_block_the_event_loop (it proves real blocking in a thread does not stall the loop, the 3 s and the < 0.5 s gap are the assertion), the 0.01-0.4 s sleeps that make concurrent calls overlap in real threads (breakers, orchestrator, questrade auth), and gauntlet/test_p4_backend_a_breaker.py:633 asyncio.sleep(1.5), a real-time wait on the SSE stream's tick loop (not in the slowest 40, and trader/api/* is off limits during the dashboard build, so not touched).
